Known science foundations of Planetary Distributed Computer.

AWS, Azure, and GCP run planetary infrastructure. CDNs serve exabytes at the edge. Volunteer grids (Folding@home hit exascale) coordinate globally. Kubernetes federates clusters. Latency-aware scheduling and Byzantine-tolerant protocols are standard practice.

Key quantity check (Folding@home peak in exaFLOP / Frontier in exaFLOP): computed ratio 0.882353 against the reference value, relative error 0.002674, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

Physical and engineering constraints on Planetary Distributed Computer.

Latency bounds what can be tightly coupled. Outages and partitions are inevitable. Security across jurisdictions is complex.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 19.18 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is volunteer peak vs intercontinental latency at 19.18 orders of magnitude (volunteer peak larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
